subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Vertex or Gemini CLI proof before merging https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991 for this issue, or accept the source-level sanitizer proof with an explicit override?
rationale: The source path and narrow patch are clear, but the affected behavior is credentialed provider runtime and the open PR itself documents a live-proof gap.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the linked PR open until exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds without exposing credentials.

options.title: Accept source proof override
options.body: A Google provider owner can merge the scoped sanitizer fix with an explicit proof override and keep live ADC/auth validation on follow-up work.

options.title: Broaden before merge
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR and combine it with a wider Vertex auth/setup repair only if maintainers want a single landing path.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the linked PR open until exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds without exposing credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has adjacent history on both the shared thinking helper boundary and Vertex ADC auth path.
